“The data is so important,” Nina Shaw tells @cindi_leive. Our next session explores whether Hollywood has changed in the years since #MeToo exploded. Shaw, who co-founded @HWDCommission, is trying to measure what has, and what hasn’t. 

Explore the data: https://t.co/RCwUyqABSU

“People speak out more now than they ever have, but so much of this is baked into the DNA” of the industry, Shaw says. She is joined by @kimmasters and @cindi_leive for a conversation about what has and hasn’t changed in Hollywood since #MeToo.
